prerequisites.zh: 使用自有测试环境和可回滚数据集，并能在应用日志或数据库审计中关联每次请求与最终 SQL。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned test environment with a reversible dataset, and correlate each request with the final SQL through application logs or database auditing.

prerequisites.zh: 先确认参数处于字符串、数字还是括号上下文，并保存正常输入及结构相同的恒真、恒假对照响应。
prerequisites.en: First identify whether the parameter is in a string, numeric, or parenthesized context, and retain normal, structurally matched true, and false control responses.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是某个最小闭合形式让恒真与恒假谓词稳定产生不同的行集、状态或业务结果，同时后端记录显示输入进入了查询结构。单独出现引号报错、一次 500、响应长度抖动、WAF 告警或页面回显原始字符串都属于假阳性边界。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a minimal closure that makes matched true and false predicates reproducibly produce different rows, status, or business results while backend records show input entering query structure. A quote error, one HTTP 500, response-length jitter, a WAF alert, or reflection of the raw string alone is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 识别出一个可重复的闭合方式和真/假差异后立即停止，不再尝试额外注释、嵌套深度或数据读取。
opsecTips.en: Stop as soon as one repeatable closure and true/false differential is identified; do not continue with extra comments, nesting depths, or data reads.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚测试行，清除请求关联标记和临时详细错误输出，并恢复参数化查询与原有日志级别。
opsecTips.en: Roll back test rows, clear request-correlation markers and temporary verbose errors, and restore parameterized queries and the original logging level.

name.zh: 注入速查与闭合边界探测

description.zh: 用于识别字符串、数字和括号上下文中的 SQL 语法边界，通过成对真假条件判断输入是否改变后端查询结构。
description.en: Identifies SQL syntax boundaries in string, numeric, and parenthesized contexts by comparing paired true and false predicates for evidence that input changed the backend query.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQL 注入边界的基础探测：以引号、注释符与恒真闭合变体逐行提交，定位字符串、数字与括号上下文中的语法边界。适用于注入测试起点，确认输入是否改变后端查询结构。
overview.en: Covers foundational SQL injection boundary probing: submitting quote, comment-marker, and always-true closure variants line by line to locate syntax boundaries across string, numeric, and parenthesis contexts. Suitable as the injection testing starting point for confirming whether input alters backend query structure.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把不可信值直接拼进 SQL 文本，使输入能关闭原字面量或表达式并追加布尔逻辑；宽松类型与多层解码会扩大可注入面。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application concatenating untrusted values directly into SQL text, letting input close the original literal or expression and append boolean logic; loose typing and multi-layer decoding widen the injectable surface.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐行提交引号、注释符与恒真闭合变体并记录响应；某行触发数据库错误或真/假对照出现稳定响应差异即确认对应闭合上下文可注入。先记录合法值建立基线，按字段类型逐个测试闭合方式，成对发送恒真与恒假条件，并记录错误位置以确定闭合深度。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit quote, comment-marker, and always-true closure variants line by line, recording responses; a row triggering database errors or a stable true/false differential confirms that closure context is injectable. Baseline with legitimate values first, test closure styles per field type, send always-true/false pairs, and note error positions to determine closure depth.

mitigation.en: Use prepared statements or parameterized APIs for all data values, applying strict type and allowlist validation separately to integers, enums, and identifiers, with unified external database errors; after the fix, replaying closure variants must show no response differences.

description.zh: 依次提交单引号、双引号、反引号与反斜杠，观察响应报错与页面差异，命中异常字符即定位注入点与闭合方式。
description.en: Cycle single/double quotes, backticks and backslashes; errors or page deltas identify the injectable parameter and its quoting.

title.zh: 注释截断恒真绕过认证

description.zh: 拼接注释截断与恒真条件变体提交，校验语句被截断改写后恒真条件成立，直接通过登录进入授权页面拿取会话。
description.en: Append admin'-- or or 1=1 comment variants; truncated checks become tautologies that pass login into authorized pages.

title.zh: 括号闭合变体适配结构
title.en: Adapt to structure with parenthesized closures

description.zh: 查询带括号包裹时改用对应前缀闭合再接恒真条件，匹配实际包裹层级后载荷恢复生效，扩大可用注入形态范围。
description.en: For parenthesized queries use ') or ')) prefixes before the tautology so the payload matches the real nesting depth.

description.zh: 提交恒假条件与恒真成对复核，响应可区分即确认输入完整进入 SQL 逻辑，为后续联合查询与盲注链定下推进起点。
description.en: Pair tautologies with falsehoods; separable responses prove the input reaches SQL logic and set the baseline for UNION/blind chains.

review.rationale: 这是确认 SQL 语法边界的请求载荷，不是 SQLMap 等工具命令。

description.zh: 绕过对明文引号与关键字的原始匹配：载荷整体百分号编码；应用解码后注入成立即成功。
description.en: Fully percent-encode the payload to evade raw quote/keyword matching; an effective decoded injection confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过只解码一次的 WAF：引号与运算符二次编码，第二层在应用内还原；语法报错出现即成功。
description.en: Encode the quote and operators twice for WAFs decoding once, with the second layer restored inside the app; a syntax error confirms success.

description.zh: 探测非常规闭合字符并绕过针对单双引号的过滤：反引号与括号闭合变体；闭合成功引发报错即成功。
description.en: Probe non-standard closure characters to bypass quote-centric filters; a closure-induced error confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过区分大小写且按空格分词的规则：用户名混合大小写并以注释替代空格；认证被绕过即成功。
description.en: Mix case and replace spaces with comments against case-sensitive tokenizing rules; a bypassed authentication confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对注释符前必须空格的解析假设：用 && 短路接注释收尾；真值条件响应与基线一致即成功。
description.en: Chain a short-circuit && into the closing comment against spacing assumptions; a true-condition response matching baseline confirms success.

description.zh: 探测反引号上下文并绕过引号过滤：直接反引号闭合后接条件；数据库报错语义变化即成功。
description.en: Close with a backtick to probe identifier contexts under quote filtering; a changed error semantics confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过把 -- 后内容整行丢弃的单行解析器：注释后接换行使后续条件落到下一行被解析；条件差异出现即成功。
description.en: Follow the comment with a newline so trailing conditions survive single-line parsers; an appearing conditional difference confirms success.

title.zh: 恒真/恒假对照与闭合变体集
title.en: Validation step 1 for Boolean Predicate and Closure Variants

description.zh: 逐行提交 AND/OR 恒真与不同闭合（'、')、')) 变体及多种注释符；与 1=2 对照行出现稳定响应差异即确认对应闭合与逻辑形式可注入。
description.en: Submit AND/OR tautologies with varied closures (', '), ')) and comment styles line by line; a stable differential against the 1=2 controls confirms that closure and logic form is injectable.

description.zh: 绕过对 OR 1=1、UNION SELECT 连续关键字的特征拦截：用内联注释切断词法组合；响应与真值基线一致即成功。
description.en: Bypass signature rules matching contiguous OR 1=1 / UNION SELECT by splitting keywords with inline comments; success when responses match the true-condition baseline.

description.zh: 绕过对引号字符串与等号组合的过滤：用 0x 十六进制字面量替代字符串常量做等值比较；登录绕过生效或延迟触发即成功。
description.en: Replace quoted string constants with hex literals to evade quote/equals filters; successful login bypass or triggered delay confirms it.

description.zh: 绕过针对 SLEEP() 函数名的规则：改用 BENCHMARK 重复计算制造延迟；响应时间较基线显著增加即成功。
description.en: Evade rules on the SLEEP() function name by inducing delay via BENCHMARK; a clearly increased response time confirms success.

title.zh: 双重 URL 编码载体

description.zh: 绕过仅做一次 URL 解码的 WAF：对 payload 整体二次百分号编码，应用层再解码一次后注入生效；出现数据库语法报错即成功。
description.en: Fully re-encode the payload twice to slip past WAFs that decode only once; a database syntax error in the response confirms success.

title.zh: SQL 注入预检语句样例

description.zh: 提供恒真条件、UNION 探列与 SLEEP 时间盲注三条预检语句，用于在授权测试中快速判断注入点行为。
description.en: Provides three preflight statements — a tautology condition, a UNION column probe, and a SLEEP time-based check — to quickly characterize an injection point in authorized testing.

title.en: Validation step 1 for SQL Injection Boundary Probes

description.zh: 逐行提交引号、注释符与恒真闭合变体并记录响应；某行触发数据库错误或真/假对照出现稳定响应差异即确认对应闭合上下文可注入。
description.en: Submit quote, comment, and tautology closure variants line by line and record responses; any line raising a database error or producing a stable true/false differential confirms that closure context is injectable.

prerequisites.zh: 确认测试查询存在可观察的返回列，并在测试表中放置不会与真实数据混淆的固定标记值。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the test query has an observable output column and place a fixed, unmistakable marker value in a test table.

prerequisites.zh: 用 NULL 或常量在隔离环境中确定列数、顺序和类型兼容性，同时保留不含 UNION 的同参数基线。
prerequisites.en: Determine column count, order, and type compatibility with NULLs or constants in isolation, while retaining the same parameter baseline without UNION.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求响应中出现只能来自受控 UNION 分支的固定标记，且 SQL 审计确认兼容列结构已并入原查询。仅有列数错误、类型转换错误、普通页面数字、用户输入回显或猜中列数但没有标记行，都不能证明 UNION 注入。
analysis.en: A positive result requires a fixed marker that can only originate from the controlled UNION branch to appear in the response, with SQL auditing confirming the compatible projection was merged into the original query. Column-count or type errors, ordinary page numbers, reflected input, or guessing the column count without a marker row do not prove UNION injection.

opsecTips.zh: 固定标记首次通过一个兼容列返回后停止，不继续枚举系统目录、用户表或敏感列。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the fixed marker is returned through one compatible column; do not enumerate catalogs, user tables, or sensitive columns.

opsecTips.zh: 删除标记行和临时视图，撤销为验证授予的 SELECT 权限，并清理页面缓存与关联查询日志中的测试值。
opsecTips.en: Delete marker rows and temporary views, revoke SELECT grants added for validation, and clear the test value from page caches and correlated query logs.

name.zh: UNION 列数与 NULL 对齐探测（跨库通用）
name.en: Cross-DBMS UNION Column-Count and NULL Alignment

description.zh: 逐步匹配原查询列数与类型，将受控 UNION SELECT 行并入响应，以验证可见的查询结构注入。
description.en: Progressively matches the original query's column count and types and merges a controlled UNION SELECT row into the response to validate visible query-structure injection.

overview.zh: 覆盖 UNION 查询注入的列结构匹配验证：以 UNION SELECT 1..5 与 NULL 序列、UNION ALL/DISTINCT 及不同闭合变体逐行探测，确定原查询列数、类型与闭合方式。
overview.en: Covers column-structure matching for UNION injection: probing line by line with UNION SELECT 1..5 and NULL sequences, UNION ALL/DISTINCT, and different closure variants to determine the original query's column count, types, and closure.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入被拼进 SELECT 条件后可结束原谓词并追加集合运算；UNION 注入要求原结果可回显且追加查询在列数、顺序与类型上兼容，错误处理与模板回显会暴露列结构。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SELECT conditions able to end the original predicate and append set operations; UNION injection requires echoable original results and appended queries compatible in column count, order, and types, with error handling and template echo exposing column structure.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 UNION SELECT 1..5 与 NULL 序列逐行探测；列数匹配时响应正常、不匹配时报错，由此确定 UNION 列数与闭合方式。从单列开始递增 NULL 占位并保留列数不匹配的负对照，再把不同无害标记放入候选可见列确认回显位；标记必须稳定出现在服务端返回的数据位置，排除请求反射与缓存。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to probe line by line with UNION SELECT 1..5 and NULL sequences; matching column counts return normally while mismatches error, fixing the UNION column count and closure. Increment NULL placeholders from one column keeping mismatched negative controls, then place distinct harmless markers into candidate visible columns to confirm echo positions; markers must appear stably in server-returned data positions, excluding request reflection and caches.

mitigation.zh: 参数化所有过滤值，动态排序、列名与表名映射到固定允许列表，数据库账户只访问业务所需表列；修复后重放各列数变体应报列不匹配。
mitigation.en: Parameterize all filter values, map dynamic ordering, column names, and table names to fixed allowlists, and restrict database accounts to business-necessary tables and columns; after the fix, replaying column-count variants must raise column-mismatch errors.

title.en: Find the column ceiling by incrementing

description.zh: 联合查询逐列递增提交载荷探测，报错消失的最后一个数字即真实列数，据此构造与原查询完全对齐的联合结构。
description.en: Grow UNION SELECT column by column; the largest count that stops erroring is the true width for an aligned UNION.

description.zh: 换成全 NULL 组合提交，空值兼容所有列类型，整条查询正常返回即列数与占位全部就绪，避免类型报错干扰。
description.en: Switch to all-NULL padding; NULL fits every column type and a clean return confirms structure readiness without type noise.

title.en: Locate echo slots with numbered columns

description.zh: 用数字与字符序列替换空值占位提交，页面出现的数字即外显列位，后续把提取的目标数据放进这些列位直接读取。
description.en: Replace padding with numbered values; whichever digits surface on the page mark the columns that can carry extracted data.

title.zh: 替换目标数据完成提取
title.en: Swap in targets to finish the dump

description.zh: 把回显位内容替换为库名函数、表名子查询与字段值，按第 3 步定位的列位依次读取数据，完成整表数据收割。
description.en: Fill the echo slots with database(), table subqueries and column values, reading through the slots found in step 3.

review.rationale: UNION SELECT 是查询结构验证载荷，应保留在 Payload 库。

description.zh: 绕过对 UNION SELECT 紧邻特征的规则：改用 UNION ALL 并注释分词；NULL 列回显正常即成功。
description.en: Switch to UNION ALL with comment splitting against adjacency signatures; normal NULL-column echoing confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过仅把空格视为分隔符的 WAF：用 %0B 垂直制表符作词间空白；三列回显即成功。
description.en: Use %0B as inter-token whitespace against space-only tokenizers; a three-column echo confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对数字列值指纹的检测：列值用十六进制字面量；回显 123 即成功。
description.en: Use hex literals as column values to defeat numeric fingerprinting; an echoed 123 confirms success.

prerequisites.zh: 从连接信息或服务端指纹确认具体 DBMS 与版本，只选择该版本实际支持的转换、XML、JSON、GTID 或空间函数。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the exact DBMS and version from connection or server evidence, and select only conversion, XML, JSON, GTID, or spatial functions supported by that version.

prerequisites.zh: 配置受控异常捕获并使用随机合成标记表达式，分别保存普通语法错误和不支持函数的对照。
prerequisites.en: Configure controlled exception capture with a random synthetic marker expression, and retain separate controls for ordinary syntax errors and unsupported functions.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是兼容的报错函数执行了受控子表达式，并在数据库异常或经过授权的测试响应中携带预置标记。通用 SQL 错误、函数不存在、版本不兼容、网关统一 500、或错误文本只重复请求内容都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a compatible error function evaluating the controlled subexpression and carrying the preset marker in a database exception or authorized test response. A generic SQL error, missing function, incompatible version, uniform gateway 500, or error text that only repeats request content is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个低敏感固定标记进入错误通道后即停止，不把版本、当前用户或真实目录内容作为后续提取目标。
opsecTips.en: Stop once one low-sensitivity fixed marker enters the error channel; do not proceed to extract versions, current users, or real catalog content.

opsecTips.zh: 恢复通用错误页与异常脱敏设置，删除测试标记和详细堆栈记录，并关闭临时数据库跟踪。
opsecTips.en: Restore generic error pages and exception redaction, delete test markers and verbose stack records, and disable temporary database tracing.

name.zh: 跨数据库报错型 SQL 注入

description.zh: 覆盖 SQL Server 类型转换和 MySQL XML、JSON、GTID、地理函数等报错通道，用受控异常验证表达式执行。
description.en: Covers SQL Server conversion errors and MySQL XML, JSON, GTID, and geospatial error channels to validate expression execution with controlled failures.

overview.zh: 覆盖跨数据库报错型注入的验证：集合横跨 SQL Server 类型转换与 MySQL XML、JSON、GTID、地理函数等报错通道，用受控异常验证表达式执行并按版本选择兼容分支。
overview.en: Covers cross-database error-based injection verification: the set spans SQL Server type conversion and MySQL XML, JSON, GTID, and geographic function error channels, verifying expression execution via controlled exceptions with version-matched branches.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入进入数据库表达式且底层异常被原样返回或可区分映射，类型转换或函数校验错误携带表达式结果；不兼容函数报错不等于数据泄露，须先确认 DBMS 与版本。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input entering database expressions with underlying exceptions returned raw or distinctly mapped, so type-conversion or function-validation errors carry expression results; incompatible-function errors are not data disclosure — confirm DBMS and version first.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令按行提交报错注入与真假对照样例；ELT/MAKE_SET 行不触发数据库异常，仅作为布尔差分探针按响应差分记录，其余报错行按异常回显记录。先比较正常表达式、固定类型错误与不存在函数三组响应，再只用与版本匹配的函数嵌入无害常量，确认服务端异常日志稳定包含受控常量并对应同一请求。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit error-based injections with true/false controls line by line; ELT/MAKE_SET rows raise no database exceptions and serve only as boolean-differential probes recorded by response differences, while remaining error rows record via exception echo. Compare normal expressions, fixed type errors, and nonexistent functions first, then embed a harmless constant only in version-matched functions, confirming server exception logs stably contain the controlled constant tied to the same request.

mitigation.en: Isolate data from expressions with parameterized queries, unify production error responses, revoke unnecessary function and catalog privileges, and monitor conversion-error spikes; after the fix, replaying each error function must return a uniform error page.

title.en: Echo the version via CONVERT errors

description.zh: 提交类型转换报错变体语句，类型转换失败的报错消息携带版本与库名返回，确认报错通道并完成数据库指纹识别。
description.en: Submit CONVERT(int,(SELECT @@version)) variants; conversion error text carries version and database names back for fingerprinting.

attackChain.payload: ' AND 1=CONVERT(int,(SELECT @@version))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND 1=CONVERT(int,(SELECT DB_NAME()))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND 1=CONVERT(int,(SELECT SYSTEM_USER))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT @@version)))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT database())))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT user())))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT @@version)),1)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT database())),1)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT user())),1)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND (SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT count(*),concat((SELECT @@version),floor(rand(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND (SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT count(*),concat((SELECT database()),floor(rand(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND (SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT count(*),concat((SELECT user()),floor(rand(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND exp(~(SELECT * FROM (SELECT @@version)a))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND exp(~(SELECT * FROM (SELECT database())a))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND exp(~(SELECT * FROM (SELECT user())a))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND GTID_SUBSET((SELECT @@version),1)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND GTID_SUBSET((SELECT database()),1)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND JSON_KEYS((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT @@version))))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND JSON_KEYS((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT database()))))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND ST_LatFromGeoHash((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT @@version))))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND ST_LatFromGeoHash((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT database()))))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND ST_LongFromGeoHash((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT @@version))))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND ST_LongFromGeoHash((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT database()))))-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND ELT(1=1,1)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND ELT(1=2,1)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND MAKE_SET(1=1,1)-- ⏎ CMD: ' AND MAKE_SET(1=2,1)--

description.en: Switch to extractvalue/updatexml wrapping subqueries; XPath errors return target contents on MySQL to open an extraction channel.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是拼接式 PostgreSQL 查询允许输入改变谓词、追加语句或调用函数，错误回显与宽权限泄露会话与数据库信息；pg_sleep 返回 void，不能作为 OR/AND 布尔操作数或与数值直接比较。

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令中堆叠 '; SELECT pg_sleep 与布尔式 AND (SELECT pg_sleep(3)) IS NOT NULL 两种有效延迟形式。建立无延时统计基线后，用最短可识别的 pg_sleep 真假分支或固定字符串 CAST 错误作为独立证据；将响应耗时与 pg_stat_activity、慢查询日志关联，排除网络抖动与锁等待。

mitigation.en: Bind parameters via the PostgreSQL driver, restrict connection-role privileges, unify error mapping, set statement timeouts, and detect abnormal pg_sleep and conversion failures; after the fix, replays must show no delay differentials.

analysis.en: Positive evidence requires reproducible resource or timing growth with controlled randomblob size on the true branch, or a fixed sqlite_version marker returned through an observable column and correlated with in-process query records. overview.en: Covers resource-consumption timing probes for SQLite: creating delays with randomblob consumption and LIKE+RANDOMBLOB variants, contrasting delay sources by data size to identify embedded-query injection.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入被拼进 SQLite 表达式后可调用内置函数或访问系统表；SQLite 常与应用进程共享 CPU 和内存，昂贵表达式同时影响可用性，需控制数据量规模。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SQLite expressions invoking built-in functions or reaching system tables; SQLite typically shares CPU and memory with the application process, so expensive expressions also affect availability — control data sizes carefully.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 randomblob 资源消耗与 LIKE+RANDOMBLOB 变体制造延迟，末两行作布尔对照；响应明显变慢且随 blob 参数减小而缩短即确认 SQLite 注入可造成可控时延。先测量固定数据集基线，再从低规模逐级增加并对比恒假分支，观察进程 CPU、内存与超时，禁止重复最大值。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to create delays with randomblob consumption and LIKE+RANDOMBLOB variants, with the last two rows as boolean controls; markedly slower responses shrinking as the blob parameter decreases confirm SQLite injection produces controllable latency. mitigation.en: Bind SQLite parameters, set execution budgets, progress handlers, and concurrency limits, restrict database-file permissions, and monitor abnormally large BLOBs and long queries; after the fix, replays must show no size-dependent delays.

prerequisites.zh: 先逐行标注 DBMS、编码层、证据通道和潜在影响，不把混合语料作为一条可直接执行的测试。
prerequisites.en: First classify every line by DBMS, encoding layer, evidence channel, and potential impact; do not treat the mixed corpus as one executable test.

prerequisites.zh: 为 UNION、盲注、目录访问和文件写入片段分别匹配已有目标卡及其独立测试环境，无法归类的行保持隔离。
prerequisites.en: Map UNION, blind, catalog-access, and file-write fragments to existing target cards and separate test environments, keeping unclassified lines isolated.

analysis.zh: 本条的阳性结果是拆分审校本身：每个片段都能被归入正确的 DBMS、解码顺序、影响等级和既有路由目标，并在目标卡中使用相应的真/假或固定标记证据。整块被 WAF 命中、某一行报语法错、编码后返回 200 或跨方言函数失败，都不能证明该混合集合可作为单一 Payload。
analysis.en: The positive result for this entry is the split review itself: every fragment is assigned the correct DBMS, decoding order, impact level, and existing route, with the target card applying its own paired or fixed-marker evidence. A WAF hit on the block, one syntax error, HTTP 200 after encoding, or failure of a cross-dialect function does not prove that the mixed corpus is a single usable payload.

opsecTips.zh: 审校遇到 OUTFILE、目录枚举或其他高影响片段时停止于分类，不在混合语料上下文中执行。
opsecTips.en: Stop at classification when review reaches OUTFILE, catalog enumeration, or another high-impact fragment; do not execute it in the mixed-corpus context.

opsecTips.zh: 删除拆分过程中建立的临时数据和编码样本，撤销文件系统测试权限，并清理未采用的分类草稿。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary data and encoding samples created during splitting, revoke filesystem test privileges, and clear discarded classification drafts.

name.zh: 跨方言 SQL/WAF 混合集（待拆分）

description.zh: 混合 MySQL、Oracle、SQLite、Access 风格语句、URL/XML 编码与文件写入影响，无法用单一前置条件解释。
description.en: Mixes MySQL, Oracle, SQLite, Access-style statements, URL/XML encodings, and file-write impact that cannot share one prerequisite model.

subCategory.zh: 混合 SQL/WAF 语料拆分

overview.zh: 跨方言 SQL/WAF 混合集（待拆分）聚焦逐行审查发现 UNION、盲注、注释混淆、XML 包装、双重编码、目录访问和 OUTFILE；单卡会掩盖 DBMS 与解析层条件。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: Mixed SQL/WAF Corpus (Split Required) focuses on this boundary: Line review found UNION, blind predicates, comment confusion, XML wrapping, double encoding, catalog access, and OUTFILE, whose DBMS and parsing prerequisites cannot fit one card. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 每行只在特定数据库、字符集、解码顺序和查询上下文中成立；WAF 接受但后端语法失败不是绕过。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: Each line works only under a specific database, charset, decoding order, and query context; passing a WAF while failing backend syntax is not bypass. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 逐行标注方言、编码层、技术和预期证据，再分别路由到 UNION、报错、Oracle、SQLite、规范化或堆叠影响卡。 每个子集都要对比原始字节、WAF 日志、应用解码值和最终 SQL；禁止把整块语料一次发送并以状态码定性。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: Label each line by dialect, encoding layer, technique, and expected evidence, then route it to UNION, error, Oracle, SQLite, normalization, or stacked-impact cards. For each subset compare raw bytes, WAF logs, application-decoded values, and final SQL; never submit the entire corpus or classify by status code. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 在单一入口严格解码和规范化，再做类型校验与参数绑定；按 DBMS 限制目录和文件写权限，WAF 仅作纵深检测。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Decode and canonicalize once, then validate types and bind parameters; restrict catalog and file-write privileges by DBMS and use the WAF only as defense in depth. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

title.zh: 确认混合 SQL/WAF 语料拆分前置条件

description.zh: 逐行审查发现 UNION、盲注、注释混淆、XML 包装、双重编码、目录访问和 OUTFILE；单卡会掩盖 DBMS 与解析层条件。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Line review found UNION, blind predicates, comment confusion, XML wrapping, double encoding, catalog access, and OUTFILE, whose DBMS and parsing prerequisites cannot fit one card. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

title.zh: 核对混合 SQL/WAF 语料拆分成功证据
title.en: Verify Mixed SQL/WAF Corpus Split evidence

description.zh: 每个子集都要对比原始字节、WAF 日志、应用解码值和最终 SQL；禁止把整块语料一次发送并以状态码定性。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: For each subset compare raw bytes, WAF logs, application-decoded values, and final SQL; never submit the entire corpus or classify by status code. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归混合 SQL/WAF 语料拆分
title.en: Remediate and regress Mixed SQL/WAF Corpus Split

description.zh: 在单一入口严格解码和规范化，再做类型校验与参数绑定；按 DBMS 限制目录和文件写权限，WAF 仅作纵深检测。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Decode and canonicalize once, then validate types and bind parameters; restrict catalog and file-write privileges by DBMS and use the WAF only as defense in depth. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

review.rationale: 原记录跨 DBMS、编码层和影响，必须拆到已有具体 Payload，而不是迁入单一工具。

prerequisites.zh: 先用参数化日志确认现有注入点，再记录目标 DBMS 中 LIKE、BETWEEN、IN 的类型转换、排序规则和边界语义。
prerequisites.en: First confirm the existing injection point through parameterized logging, then record the target DBMS's coercion, collation, and boundary semantics for LIKE, BETWEEN, and IN.

prerequisites.zh: 为每种替代运算符构造结构相同的恒真与恒假谓词，并保留使用等号的规范版本作为过滤对照。
prerequisites.en: Build structurally matched true and false predicates for each substitute operator, retaining the canonical equality form as a filtering control.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求替代运算符到达后端并使恒真、恒假结果稳定分离；若声称绕过过滤，还必须证明等号版本被拦截而语义等价的替代形式执行。因通配符、排序规则、NULL 或边界包含规则造成的正常行数差异，单纯语法错误或输入回显均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive result requires the substitute operator to reach the backend and reproducibly separate matched true and false outcomes. A filtering-bypass claim also requires the equality form to be blocked while the equivalent substitute executes. Normal row-count differences caused by wildcards, collation, NULL, or inclusive boundaries, plus syntax errors or input reflection, are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 确认一个运算符的配对差异后停止，不继续组合多个运算符或扩大到目录查询。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming the paired differential for one operator; do not combine multiple operators or expand into catalog queries.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚用于比较的测试行，清除查询缓存和临时 WAF 例外，并恢复原排序规则与参数校验。
opsecTips.en: Roll back comparison rows, clear query caches and temporary WAF exceptions, and restore the original collation and parameter validation.

name.zh: 比较运算符等价替换

description.zh: 用 LIKE、BETWEEN 和 IN 替代等号构造等价真值条件，验证防护是否只做表面运算符匹配。
description.en: Uses LIKE, BETWEEN, and IN instead of equality to create equivalent true predicates and test superficial operator filtering.

overview.zh: 覆盖比较运算符替代注入验证：以 LIKE、BETWEEN 和 IN 替代等号构造等价真值条件，检测防护是否只做表面运算符匹配。
overview.en: Covers comparison-operator substitution injection: building equivalent truth conditions with LIKE, BETWEEN, and IN replacing equals, testing whether defenses do only surface operator matching.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用继续拼接 SQL 却只在黑名单中删除等号，数据库支持的其他比较运算符仍可维持相同布尔语义；黑名单式过滤对等价运算符族无防御力。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is applications still concatenating SQL while blacklists delete only equals signs, leaving other database comparison operators to preserve identical boolean semantics; blacklist filtering is defenseless against equivalent operator families.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 LIKE/BETWEEN/IN 等价替代等号构造恒真/恒假条件；真条件响应与 1=1 基线一致、假条件出现差异即确认等号被过滤时这些运算符可替代注入。先用等号真假条件建立基线，再只替换运算符并保持引号、空白与其他请求字节不变，核对最终谓词与业务记录集合的等价性。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to build always-true/false conditions with LIKE/BETWEEN/IN equivalently replacing equals; true-condition responses matching the 1=1 baseline with false-condition differences confirm these operators substitute when equals is filtered. Baseline with equals true/false conditions first, then swap only the operator keeping quotes, whitespace, and other request bytes unchanged, verifying predicate and business-record-set equivalence.

mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries with strict type binding without expanding operator blacklists; normalize charsets uniformly and regression-test every equivalent operator; after the fix, replaying operator variants must show no differences.

title.zh: LIKE 替代等号构造条件

description.zh: 等号被过滤时用模式匹配改写恒真判断提交，语义与等值比较完全等价，布尔盲注的真假分支保持可区分继续推进。
description.en: Rewrite equality tests with LIKE when '=' is filtered; pattern semantics stay equivalent so boolean branches remain separable.

review.rationale: 这些是 SQL 运算符替代载荷，不是字典工具命令。

description.en: Switch to REGEXP predicates when LIKE/BETWEEN/IN are already signature-listed; distinguishable true/false responses confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对比较运算符族的过滤：用极值函数构造等价布尔表达式；条件差异稳定复现即成功。
description.en: Build equivalent booleans with min/max functions against comparison-operator filters; stably reproducible condition differences confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对 AND LIKE 小写全字匹配：关键字内插注释并混合大小写；谓词语义保持即成功。
description.en: Insert comments inside keywords with mixed case against lowercase whole-word matching; preserved predicate semantics confirm success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Comparison-Operator Substitution Injection
